Title: I Tested AI Cloning… and It’s Way Worse Than You Think!
Description:
I used AI to reverse engineer real binaries, understand how they work, and then clone their functionality into brand-new applications. In this video I show the full process — what the AI can actually figure out, where it falls short, and how far you can push the technique of turning an existing binary into something new.

This is the practical side of AI-assisted reverse engineering, not theory.

What you’ll see:

How AI helps tear apart and understand binaries
Extracting logic, behavior, and structure
Cloning that functionality into a clean new application
Real examples of what works and what still needs a human engineer
The limits, risks, and surprising capabilities of current tools

If you’ve ever wondered how far AI can go in reverse-engineering and recreating software from binaries, this is the deep dive.
